faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kashipur Administrative Trainee/ Associate (MPRC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIM Kashipur Administrative Trainee/ Associate (MPRC) positions is 03 September 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIM Kashipur?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kashipur has released a total of 1 vacancy for the Administrative Trainee/ Associate (MPRC) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first-class bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Journalism, Communication, or Marketing. For the Associate role, a postgraduate degree with three years of relevant experience is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Administrative Trainee/ Associate (MPRC) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 45 years. There are no specified minimum age limits mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Administrative Trainee/ Associate (MPRC) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 24,500/- to Rs. 45,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIM Kashipur recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview, which can be conducted either in person or online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIM Kashipur Administrative Trainee/ Associate (MPRC) recruitment must be submitted online through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contract-based job at the Indian Institute of Management Kashipur.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIM Kashipur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kashipur is located in Kashipur, Uttarakhand.
